## Fix: Showall of a whole disk froze the screen

Showall (and Branch) of a tree with millions of files held the screen for
seconds while Xylem sorted the list: about 5 s with 2,000,000 files, every
time the list was built again. The sort now keeps the names in one buffer and
moves small keys instead of whole entries, so the same list takes 0.66 s on
the same machine (from 4.9 s), in every sort order (Name, Ext, Date, Size,
ascending or descending, with the path first or not). The order of the files
does not change: a test compares it with the old sort in every mode.

Nothing else changes from 0.9.0.

## Install

Download the archive for your system below (Linux x86_64 or ARM64, static;
Windows x86_64), a `.deb` or `.rpm` package, or `cargo install xylem-fm`. The
website: https://andrelnfernandes.github.io/xylem/
